deviations.topic: no AdapterId newtype / separate registry module exists yet
deviations.detail: The workpack's prose refers to 'the arc-23 Adapter registry' resolving stubs 'by id' via 'a typed AdapterId newtype (from enforcer-domain, arc-02)'. No such newtype or dedicated registry module exists in this checkout (edd5eb3) -- registration today is: implement crate::core::HarnessAdapter, and the caller builds its own `Vec<&dyn HarnessAdapter>` (see crate::core::select_adapters, crate::core::install/uninstall/doctor). c08 followed the existing, real pattern (identical to c03/c06/c07): harness_key() returns the static str id ("gemini"/"cursor"/"zed"), and adapters/mod.rs gained exactly the three `pub mod` lines this workpack owns. Registry-miss / unknown-id proof is covered via crate::core::select_adapters's existing InstallError::UnknownAdapter typed-error path (see an_unregistered_harness_key_is_a_typed_error_not_a_silent_skip), which is the real mechanism this codebase uses for 'registry miss -> fails'. If/when arc-02's AdapterId newtype and a dedicated registry module land, these three stubs' harness_key() strings are the values that would populate it -- no interface change needed on this module's side.
